message.content:
A vertical red magazine cover for "TEMPO" features black and white text and a central illustration. At the top, "BAHAYA UNDANG-UNDANG KONFLIK SOSIAL," "KILANG PERTAMINA TERGANJAL FISKAL," and "BAGAIMANA GEMPA SUMATERA TERJADI" are printed in white. Large black letters spell "TEMPO" across the upper third. Below, "EDISI 16-22 APRIL 2012" is in white.

The illustration depicts a man with white skin and short hair, wearing glasses, a white shirt, a black tie, a black jacket, and black pants with white shoes. He is shown horizontally in mid-air, face up, with arms and legs raised as if falling or being tossed. His body is positioned between the title and a large white headline: "TANGAN JAKARTA DI SERAMBI MEKAH."

Below this text, numerous black and dark red silhouetted hands and arms reach upward from the bottom edge. One arm wears a green and brown camouflage-patterned sleeve. The hands are in various gestures, some with open palms and others with fingers curled. In the bottom left, "RP 29.700," a website, and a barcode are visible.
